create_BaseFormatter: create a subclass of BaseFormatter that implements the format method to transform document text
run_BaseFormatter: run a BaseFormatter subclass on a DocumentsPipeline to apply text formatting to each document
test_BaseFormatter: test a BaseFormatter subclass by passing sample text to its format method and verifying output
refactor_BaseFormatter: refactor a BaseFormatter subclass to add custom text transformation logic in the format method
review_BaseFormatter: review the BaseFormatter class and its run method that iterates over a DocumentsPipeline applying format to each document
